generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE standalone square 1:1 RPG comment avatar for an anonymous speaking NPC ("Fremde Stimme"). One image only, never a sheet, grid, collage or icon badge.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND SERIES REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its anonymous near-black human silhouette, matte anime linework and cel-shading, simple medieval village backdrop, calm daylight, muted palette and large upper-body framing. Create the new role described below.
Scene: a quiet uncomplicated medieval village lane with two or three cream plaster-and-timber cottages, muted brown roofs, a little subdued greenery and soft blue sky. Background light and lower contrast than the figure, no crowd or signs.
Subject and framing: one centered human adult, waist-up, head comfortably below the top edge, conversational gesturing hands fully inside the frame. Human face, head, hands, all exposed skin, clothing and equipment remain nearly black charcoal, with only sparse flat dark-slate outlines to distinguish broad garment shapes. Absolutely no eyes, nose, mouth, skin-colored patches, visible facial planes or facial detail. This is an anonymous living human speaking, not a ghost, monster, statue or assassin.
Style: match the supplied existing Tales of Xillia/Frieren-inspired clean matte anime / cel-shaded silhouette series. Clear simple contours, restrained flat values, no photorealism, realistic textures, painterly finish, bright metallic highlights or detailed materials. Keep the outer contour and conversational gesture exceptionally readable as a 48px thumbnail.
Constraints: opaque full-square village scene, no transparency. No text, speech bubbles, watermark, border or frame. No invented heraldry, insignia, uniforms, religious emblems or decorative symbols. Natural human anatomy. Equipment is for recognizing the role through its dark silhouette, not for violence. No aggressive pose, fighting, blood or injury.
NEW ROLE: An adult human knight recognizable by the broad outer shapes of plain plate armor, a closed featureless helmet/visor and a simple cloak. One open gauntleted hand extends in a measured conversational gesture, the other arm rests naturally near the waist. Armor and visor remain nearly black with very sparse flat dark-slate divisions, no bright steel, no face or eyes through the helmet, no heraldry, crest, badge or religious sign. No drawn weapon, shield, attack or fighting.
